books.title: The Lantern Keeper's Daughter
books.author: Isolde Varga
books.description:
Every night for three hundred years, a Varrow has lit the great lantern above the harbour of Sel. When her father vanishes on the eve of the winter storms, Maren takes up the keys, and finds that the light has been holding back far more than ships on the rocks.

A quiet, luminous fantasy about inheritance, duty, and the stories families tell to keep the dark at bay.

books.title: Salt and Iron
books.author: Tobias Wren
books.description: The tide-cities of the Shallows trade in salt and sell their sailors' names. Kesh has never owned hers. When a drowned ship surfaces carrying a crown no one admits to losing, she has one season to sail it home before three fleets decide it belongs to them.

books.title: Salt and Fire
books.author: Tobias Wren
books.description: The crown is home, and the Shallows are burning. Kesh and her crew chase a fire that walks on water across the southern reefs, into a war that remembers her name better than she does.

books.title: A Small Map of Everything
books.author: Noor Haddad
books.description: Four siblings return to the house where they grew up to divide what's left of it: furniture, photographs, and a hand-drawn map of the neighbourhood their mother kept updating until the day she died. Tender and very funny.

books.title: The Clockmaker of Vell
books.author: Ansel Moravec
books.description: In Vell, every citizen's lifespan is wound into a clock kept in the Guildhall. Apprentice Tomas Reyk discovers a clock with no name on it, still ticking, and set to stop tomorrow.

books.title: Quiet Engines
books.author: Priya Raman
books.description: A generation ship has been silent for ninety years. Its engineers have forgotten why. When the engines start again, the only person who can read the old manuals is a twelve-year-old who learned the language from a children's song.

books.title: Notes from a Northern Garden
books.author: Elin Sandvik
books.description: A year in a small garden above the Arctic Circle, month by month: what grows, what doesn't, and what a patch of stubborn ground teaches about patience.

books.title: The Cartographer's Error
books.author: Julian Ashby
books.description: London, 1852. A respected mapmaker is found dead beside a survey of streets that do not exist. His apprentice has a week to find out who wanted them drawn, and who wanted them erased.

books.title: Under a Paper Moon
books.author: Mei Lin Zhao
books.description: Two rival paper-lantern makers are forced to share a stall at the autumn festival. One of them has been sabotaging the other's lanterns for years. Neither of them knows which.

books.title: The Long Way Down the River
books.author: Samuel Okafor
books.description: Three old friends take a borrowed boat a thousand miles downriver to scatter the ashes of a fourth. It takes them a summer, two breakdowns, and one wedding they were not invited to.

books.title: Ember Protocol
books.author: Kasia Nowak
books.description: A climate engineer discovers the cloud-seeding system she designed is being used to choose which cities get rain. She has nine days and one working satellite link to turn it off.

books.title: The Orchard at World's End
books.author: Lucia Ferrante
books.description: On a windswept island, three generations of women tend an orchard planted by a man none of them can agree about. A novel of apples, grudges, and forgiveness that takes its time.

books.title: How Rivers Remember
books.author: Hana Mori
books.description: A hydrologist explains how rivers carry the record of every flood, drought and dam in their beds, and what that memory tells us about the century ahead.

books.title: The Ninth Lighthouse
books.author: Rowan Hale
books.description: There are eight lighthouses on the charts of the Grey Coast. Fishermen swear there is a ninth. When a coastguard officer sees it lit, she rows out to prove them wrong.

books.title: Glass Birds
books.author: Ines Calder
books.description: Twelve stories about fragile things: a glassblower's last commission, a museum night guard, a family that keeps a sparrow alive through one long winter.

books.title: The Weight of Small Hours
books.author: Ada Thorne
books.description: A night-shift nurse, a radio host and an insomniac teenager are connected by one phone call made at 3:14 in the morning. Over a single year, it changes all three of them.

books.title: Starlight Ledger
books.author: Callum Reyes
books.description: An accountant on a mining station finds a debt in the books that predates the station itself, owed to someone who is coming to collect.

books.title: A Field Guide to Forgetting
books.author: Oren Vale
books.description: Essays on memory and its useful failures: lost languages, misremembered songs, and the town that agreed to forget an entire decade.

books.title: The Winter Archive
books.author: Sofia Lindqvist
books.description: Stockholm, 1944. An archivist hides refugees' papers among the city's tax records, and keeps a second, secret archive of everyone she could not save.

books.title: Copper and Thread
books.author: Malik Adeyemi
books.description: In a city where spells are woven into cloth, a tailor's son is accused of stitching a curse into the governor's coat. He didn't. He knows who did.

books.title: Midnight at the Paper Mill
books.author: Greta Holm
books.description: A retired schoolteacher, a mill that closed forty years ago, and a ream of paper delivered to her door every Tuesday with no return address.

books.title: The Patient Mountain
books.author: Tenzin Clarke
books.description: After a failed expedition, a climber returns to the same mountain every spring for ten years, never to summit, only to learn its moods.

books.title: Tidewater Songs
books.author: Tobias Wren
books.description: The final voyage of the Tidebound Chronicles. Kesh sails beyond the last charted reef to find out who first sold the Shallows' names, and whether they can be bought back.

books.title: The Last Bookbinder
books.author: Isolde Varga
books.description: In a city where every book has been replaced by a single official edition, an old binder repairs the last private library, one forbidden page at a time.
